🌎 BEYOND THE 956

British actor and comedian Russell Brand was convicted Thursday of rape and sexual assault in a London court, and was taken into custody ahead of his sentencing.

A jury at Southwark Crown Court found Brand, 51, guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. The jury cleared him of two other rape charges and one count of attempted indecent assault.

The charges involved six women and dated back to incidents between 1999 and 2009. Brand had denied all of the charges and pleaded not guilty.

Judge Joel Bennathan denied Brand's request for bail and remanded him into custody, warning that he faces a significant prison sentence when he returns to court for sentencing on Monday, November 9.

London Metropolitan Police Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy praised the women who came forward, calling the conviction a testament to their extraordinary courage, resilience, and determination.

The women in the case are entitled to lifelong anonymity under UK law, and their names have not been published.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram; Metropolitan Police; Reuters; USA Today.
